hooks.text: 桌面上的每个玩具槽位都是构筑决策，要组合稀有单位并调整阵形释放完整Build潜力
hooks.excerpt: Master the art of toy arrangement on your tabletop! Every toy slot is a strategic decision. Plan your layout, combine rare units, and arrange them wisely to unlock your build’s full potential!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 四百多种策略玩具覆盖百种召唤物、五十多种陷阱与职业能力、二百五十多件魔法装备
hooks.excerpt: Craft your own tactical system from over 400 strategic toys! 100+ summons to clash in tabletop battles 50+ traps and class abilities to outsmart your opponents and shift momentum 250+ magic items and weapons to power up your strategy and unleash devastating combos
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 可把Steam好友变成全副武装的Game Buddy，自定义武器和属性后编入玩具军团
hooks.excerpt: Transform your Steam friends into fully armed "Game Buddy", customize them with all kinds of weapons and attributes, then rally them into your toy army to charge into battle for friendship!
